title: On scattering and profile decomposition for critical nonlinear waves outside weakly trapping obstacles
summary: We prove scattering for the defocusing energy-critical non-linear wave equation with Dirichlet boundary conditions outside two strictly convex obstacles in dimension three. This is the first large data scattering result for such an equation in the presence of trapped trajectories. Our result is in fact more general and can be used as a black box in other geometries.
